title: Two Margins in Difference-in-Differences with a Continuous Treatment
abstract: arXiv:2609.09488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies difference-in-differences with staggered adoption and a continuous, time-invariant dose. Each cohort-time comparison contains two margins. The level margin is the average treatment effect at realized doses. Under level parallel trends it equals the level contrast between the treated cohort and not-yet-treated controls. The response margin is the within-cohort slope of the outcome change on dose. It uses no controls, and its causal interpretation requires a response parallel trends assumption and a restriction on selection on gains. We show that the continuous-dose OLS coefficient in each cohort-time comparison is a convex combination of the response index and the level contrast per unit of mean dose, with a mixing weight that depends on the not-yet-treated share. We provide estimators of both margins, joint inference across cohort-time comparisons and event-time aggregates, and a covariate-adjusted extension. In an app

translated_title: 连续处理双重差分中的两种边际
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有渐进式采纳（staggered adoption）和连续、不随时间变化剂量的双重差分方法。每个队列-时间比较包含两种边际：水平边际是实际剂量下的平均处理效应，在水平平行趋势假设下，它等于处理组队列与尚未处理对照组之间的水平对比；响应边际是队列内结果变化对剂量的斜率，它不使用对照样本，其因果解释需要响应平行趋势假设以及对增益选择的一定限制。我们证明，每个队列-时间比较中的连续剂量OLS系数是响应指数与单位平均剂量下水平对比的凸组合，混合权重取决于尚未处理组的份额。我们提供了两种边际的估计量、跨队列-时间比较和事件时间汇总的联合推断方法，以及协变量调整的扩展形式。
tldr: 本文研究了连续剂量、渐进式采纳下的双重差分，证明OLS系数实际上是水平边际与响应边际的凸组合，并为这两种边际提供了分别的估计量、联合推断及协变量调整方法。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in staggered-adoption difference-in-differences with a continuous dose, the OLS coefficient is a convex combination of two distinct margins—a level margin and a response margin—and provides estimators, joint inference, and covariate-adjusted extensions for both.
